Assign an EIP. Both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are supported. The EIP service enables your cloud resources to communicate with the Internet using static public IP addresses and scalable bandwidths. EIPs can be bound to or unbound from ECSs, BMSs, virtual IP addresses, load balancers, and NAT gateways. Various billing modes are provided to meet diverse service requirements.
